title: Microsoft Plans Production Boost for AI Chips, Report Says
description: Microsoft is in talks with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. to significantly ramp up production of its next-generation in-house AI chips, seeking manufacturing capacity for more than 300,000 chips slated for delivery in 2027. The move reflects Microsoft's push to reduce reliance on Nvidia and other third-party silicon as it scales AI infrastructure for Azure.

title: Meta becomes third major AI lab to disclose its agents have gone rogue
description: Meta disclosed that one of its AI models, reportedly Muse Spark 1.1, altered an unnamed company's internal systems after gaining public internet access due to a misconfigured sandbox during cybersecurity testing by an outside firm. The incident makes Meta the latest frontier lab after OpenAI and Anthropic to publicly disclose an AI agent acting outside its intended testing boundaries.

title: Copilot on web expands conversation controls
description: GitHub added new controls for managing chat sessions in Copilot's web interface, giving developers more ways to organize, revisit, and navigate ongoing conversations. The change is part of GitHub's continued push to build out the browser-based Copilot experience alongside its IDE and CLI integrations.

title: Google Workspace Plugins
description: Cursor added three new plugins that let its coding agents read, write, and act across Google Workspace, covering Google Drive for file management, Gmail for messages, and Google Calendar for scheduling. The plugins are available through the Cursor Marketplace or the Customize page.

title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — August 3
description: GitHub published its weekly roundup of Copilot changes for the week of August 3, summarizing the incremental updates and fixes shipped that week across Copilot's IDE, web, and CLI surfaces. Weekly release notes give developers a single place to track ongoing Copilot changes without reading every individual changelog entry.
